notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Increased the frequency of lightning strikes in Chapter 2 to improve visibility during stealth sequences.

Tweaked AI audio cues in Chapter 2 to make it easier to gauge enemy positioning.



Hope these changes enhance your experience—and as always, thank you for the continued support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Certain key items will now emit a subtle glow by default, making them easier to spot without needing to be directly observed first.

Addressed an issue where the mouse cursor could drift while navigating menus. While I was unable to reproduce this during extensive playtesting, this update includes a potential fix.

 Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: CLAIRE - Official Release Date Trailer Premiere!
notes.notes:
🎬 Watch the Official Release Date Trailer for Claire!

The wait is almost over. Claire, the spiritual sequel to Ethel, is nearly here, and it's scarier, deeper, and more intense than ever.

In this new trailer, get a glimpse of the atmosphere, puzzles, and horrors that await you in Claire. From improved lighting and AI to new gameplay mechanics and terrifying sound design, this is the most immersive experience I’ve created yet!

🗓️ Release Date Reveal – Find out when Claire launches.

notes.title: Release Date Trailer Drops May 17th!!!
notes.notes:
Claire – Release Date Trailer Launches May 17th



It’s almost time. Claire’s Release Date Trailer drops on May 17th, and you won’t want to miss it.



This intense horror experience follows the story left behind in Ethel and brings new gameplay mechanics, scares, and story depth. The trailer will reveal when Claire officially launches, along with fresh footage to give you a taste of what’s coming.



Set your calendars. Get ready. Claire is almost here.
